fusions.name: Pass It On
fusions.desc: Sends a letter into the first enemy it meets for 7 damage. It then copies itself to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each copy dealing 60% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Lien Placed
fusions.desc: Binds the target in linked pages, dealing 14 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds. The target is 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Hindered] for 5 seconds, slowing its attacks.

fusions.name: Joint Signatories
fusions.desc: Links every ally within 5 tiles under one contract: each strikes 15% harder for 9 seconds and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: No Escape Clause
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them.
